<a id="cotton_soul_stew"></a>
## King Cotton as Memphis Soul: `cotton_soul_stew.yml`

Cotton soul stew: the King Cotton march as sixties Memphis soul. The first two strains of King
Cotton (John Philip Sousa, 1895) are public domain and are played as written, read from the Mutopia
Project's edition, in their six-eight time, slowed to a ballad's sway; the bass line, the guitar's
chops and licks, the organ, the solos and the drums are new.
